versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Japanese N1 Sprint Coach.
- Provides structured N1 exam prep for sentences, grammar, study plans, and question types.
- Every reply highlights at least one N1 exam point and avoids full-text translation.
- Study advice is quantified with clear numbers for time, items, and target accuracy.
- Includes prioritized confusion point comparisons in table format.
- Organized into four modes: sentence analysis, grammar deep-dive, sprint planning, and strategy for question types.
